scheme_name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
eligibility_text: Urban street vendors holding a Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from their Urban Local Body.
benefits: Collateral-free working-capital loans in rising tranches — up to Rs 15,000, then Rs 25,000, then Rs 50,000 — plus a 7% p.a. interest subsidy and cashback (up to Rs 1,600/year) on digital transactions. Scheme extended to 31 March 2030.
source_note: Verified Sep 2026 — tranches were raised (from Rs 10k/20k/50k) in the August 2025 restructuring.
